description: This file defines a CommandResolver enum that provides functions for resolving, constructing, and managing commands and paths related to the 'openclaw' application. It includes logic for locating executables, resolving project root directories, handling SSH remote command execution, and managing environment paths.

methods.name: gatewayEntrypoint
methods.description: Determines the main entry point script for the application based on the project root directory, checking for 'dist/index.js', 'openclaw.mjs', or 'bin/openclaw.js'.

methods.name: runtimeResolution
methods.description: Resolves the runtime configuration, returning a Result with either RuntimeResolution or an error, using preferred search paths.

methods.name: makeRuntimeCommand
methods.description: Constructs a command array to run a specific runtime with an entry point, subcommand, and additional arguments.

methods.name: runtimeErrorCommand
methods.description: Generates a command array to output an error message related to runtime resolution failures.

methods.name: errorCommand
methods.description: Creates a shell command that outputs an error message and exits with status 1.

methods.name: projectRoot
methods.description: Determines the project root directory, checking stored user defaults and falling back to a default directory.

methods.name: setProjectRoot
methods.description: Stores the project root path in user defaults.

methods.name: projectRootPath
methods.description: Returns the path of the project root directory.

methods.name: preferredPaths
methods.description: Builds a list of preferred executable search paths, including environment PATH, home directories, and project-local paths.

methods.name: findExecutable
methods.description: Searches for an executable file with a given name within specified search paths.

methods.name: openclawExecutable
methods.description: Locates the 'openclaw' helper executable in specified search paths.

methods.name: projectOpenClawExecutable
methods.description: Locates the project-specific 'openclaw' executable if available, typically in node_modules/.bin.

methods.name: nodeCliPath
methods.description: Locates the path to the node CLI script for the project.

methods.name: hasAnyOpenClawInvoker
methods.description: Checks if any invoker for 'openclaw' is available in the environment, either local or via common tools.

methods.name: openclawNodeCommand
methods.description: Constructs a command array to invoke 'openclaw' with a subcommand and extra arguments, handling remote SSH execution if configured.

methods.name: openclawCommand
methods.description: An alias for openclawNodeCommand with the same parameters.

methods.name: connectionSettings
methods.description: Retrieves remote connection settings from user defaults or configuration files, encapsulating target, identity, project root, and CLI path.

methods.name: connectionModeIsRemote
methods.description: Checks if the current connection mode is set to remote.

methods.name: parseSSHTarget
methods.description: Parses an SSH target string into its user, host, and port components, validating the format.

methods.name: sshTargetValidationMessage
methods.description: Provides validation messages for SSH target string formats.

methods.name: makeSSHTarget
methods.description: Constructs an SSH target structure from user, host, and port components after validation.

methods.name: sshArguments
methods.description: Builds a list of SSH command-line arguments for connecting to a remote target with optional identity and custom options.
